{{Short description|American physicist and entrepreneur (1931–2021)}}

'''George Secor Stranahan''' (November 5, 1931, in [[Toledo, Ohio|Toledo]] – May 20, 2021, in [[Denver]]) was an American physicist and entrepreneur, best remembered for founding the [[Flying Dog Brewery]], [[Stranahan's Colorado Whiskey]], and the [[Aspen Center for Physics]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Hagerty |first1=James R. |title=George Stranahan Made a Mark in Physics and Craft Brewing |url=https://www.wsj.com/articles/george-stranahan-made-a-mark-in-physics-and-craft-brewing-11624629600 |access-date=16 May 2022 |work=Wall Street Journal |date=25 June 2021}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{cite news |last1=Traub |first1=Alex |title=George Stranahan, Benefactor of Physicists and Bar Flies, Dies at 89 |url=https://www.nytimes.com/2021/06/20/us/george-stranahan-dead.html |access-date=16 May 2022 |work=The New York Times |date=20 June 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Sackariason |first1=Carolyn |title=Valley legend George Stranahan dies, leaves behind storied legacy |url=https://www.aspentimes.com/news/valley-legend-george-stranahan-dies-leaves-behind-storied-legacy/ |access-date=16 May 2022 |work=Aspen Times}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{cite web |title=George Stranahan |url=https://aspenhalloffame.org/inductee/george-stranahan/ |website=Aspen Hall of Fame |access-date=16 May 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=Crowther |first1=Linnea |title=George Stranahan (1931–2021), physicist who founded Flying Dog Brewery |url=https://www.legacy.com/news/celebrity-deaths/george-stranahan-1931-2021-physicist-who-founded-flying-dog-brewery/ |website=Legacy.com |access-date=16 May 2022 |date=21 June 2021}}</ref>  His family owned the [[Champion (spark plug)|Champion Spark Plug Company]], and his inheritance was used to found these ventures.<ref name=":0" /> He founded the [[Woody creek tavern|Woody Creek Tavern]], which was the favorite watering hole of [[Hunter S. Thompson]], who was also Stranahan's best friend.<ref name=":1" /> He founded and was principal of the [[Aspen Community School]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Sackariason |first=Carolyn |title=Valley legend George Stranahan dies, leaves behind storied legacy |url=https://www.postindependent.com/news/valley-legend-george-stranahan-dies-leaves-behind-storied-legacy/ |access-date=2022-05-17 |website=www.postindependent.com |language=en-US|archive-date=Feb 8, 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230208075950/https://www.postindependent.com/news/valley-legend-george-stranahan-dies-leaves-behind-storied-legacy/|url-status=live}}</ref>
